title: Automated Analysis of Conservation Strategies for Endangered Species through AI-Driven Literature Review

contributions.purpose: 梳理并归类濒危物种保护策略
contributions.mechanism: 从 Web of Science/Scopus/Google Scholar 检索、按纳入排除标准筛选文献,归纳为栖息地保护、物种恢复、政策法律、社区参与、监测与数据管理五类
contributions.evaluation: 定性综述,给出各策略代表案例(如亚马逊河龟 40 年保护使偷猎降至 2%)
contributions.domain: AI 辅助生物多样性保护(叙事式文献综述)
contributions.source_quote: This study reviews recent applications of AI-based systems in literature review, ecological monitoring, and risk detection, and compares these approaches with traditional conservation methods.

contributions.purpose: 刻画 AI 在保护领域的应用趋势
contributions.mechanism: 统计发表量/引用量随时间变化并比较各技术使用频率
contributions.evaluation: AI/ML/DL 监测与物种识别使用最频繁;发表量年增 28.1%、引用量年增 35.6%(2020 后陡增,图2B)
contributions.source_quote: the number of publications increased by 28.1 percent per year, while the number of citations grew by 35.6 percent per year.

contributions.purpose: 总结物种组与地区间策略应用差异
contributions.mechanism: 按哺乳/鸟/植物类群及大洲/国家对比保护策略侧重
contributions.evaluation: 定性描述(如大型哺乳动物侧重反偷猎;中印东南亚重建保护区;非洲重社区参与)
contributions.source_quote: Endangered species conservation strategies exhibit different characteristics by continent and country.

notes: 非实证类叙事综述,无自研方法/实验,无 PRISMA 式系统检索协议(检索词与筛选标准描述极粗)。协议适配问题:四元组的 evaluation 多为转述他人案例数字(93% 物种识别精度、50 倍加速、偷猎降 50%、100% 鹦鹉识别),非作者自测,可信度依赖被引原文。AI 自我披露:标题区印有 'liner.com / chatgpt.com',结论明写 'This paper is a review created using generative AI tools such as Liner and ChatGPT',并承认'numerous areas for improvement, human involvement remains crucial'。数据红旗:图2B 发表/引用曲线与 28.1%/35.6% 年增数字无数据来源标注,疑似 AI 生成的示意图。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+各节归纳。
